items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: Joe Morris used to play with us too, with Kid Sheik.

ctx.x: Yeah. Joe Morris used to play with us too, with Kid Sheik. Yeah. When was that? Early or was that? That was back in 1948, wasn't it? When Joe Morris was playing. Remember when we used to play by Miss Bessie?

About Little Joe? Or Daddy. His daddy. He used to play two ways to move into. Yeah. So, when you made that record, the one down there, you know, that we all made out, Tulane, that was more or less a regular band, I mean, together, you know what I mean? It was, it wasn't just pick up. No, we hadn't been playing together, you know. We had been playing together. We were all we know when it wasn't too much for, when we'd add something.
When we had something, we'd use that full band. Yeah.
